area_context.name: Whitefield
area_context.trend_summary: Prices have risen ~9% over the past 12 months driven by IT sector hiring and ITPL/EPIP zone expansion. Demand remains strong in the 80L–1.5Cr segment.
area_context.metro_access_summary: Purple Line (Baiyappanahalli–Whitefield) now operational. Most societies are 10–25 minutes by auto or cab to the nearest metro station. Walking access is limited.
area_context.traffic_summary: Significant peak-hour congestion on Varthur Road and ITPL Main Road. Residents typically budget 45–90 minutes for commutes to Central or South Bengaluru during peak hours.
area_context.livability_summary: Strong IT-centric neighbourhood with good retail, hospitals, and schools. Weekend options have improved significantly. Best suited for IT professionals working in the Whitefield corridor.
area_context.community_notes: Varthur lake pollution is a long-standing concern. The lake restoration project is ongoing but buyers near the lake should verify flood history.
